summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction of the semicircle figure: diameter M–N with center O, top point P on the arc's vertical radius, point A on OP, point B on the arc, chords A–B and O–B. All six labels (M, N, O, P, A, B) are present and placed to match the original. No right-angle marks were drawn, since the CV detector verified none. Latest version is v6 (critic score 0.86, must_repair=false). The only residual difference is stroke weight, where the critic's verdicts contradict each other across versions.
